title: post-checkout.intent runs intent sync --apply in every new git worktree, and what that does there is unmeasured
body:
Every `git worktree add` on a machine with the post-pull carriers installed now runs `intent sync --apply` in the new worktree, and what that does there is unmeasured.

**Since 3d778acf4** Intent's own repository carries `post-checkout.intent`, which git also runs for `git worktree add` (a branch checkout, flag 1). The carrier runs `intent sync --apply` in the new worktree under the real HOME. The release gate, every lane's scratch worktree and the trawl kit all create worktrees.

**The ask:** measure what the pass does in a fresh worktree of a project with canon and no store: whether it builds a store there, how long it takes, whether it registers the throwaway path in `~/.config/intent/projects.json` (the 0445 class), and whether a worktree should be skipped by the carrier. XS to measure, the fix sized by the answer.



CLOSED 2026-09-19, by the commit that carries this close, in ic's stacked landing on vc's ruling on the numbers (patch-id c0583fc17, judged green; the landing run over 0480, 0479 and 0483 together on 2cd1de145: intentsvcs 1510, intent-cli 716, intentd 39, 0 failed). MEASURED, under an isolated HOME with the 3.1.0 pair: `git worktree add` with the carrier took 0.28s and built a 316 KB store on a one-thread project, against 0.05s and no store with hooks off; on a clone of a 123-thread estate it took 322s and built a 75 MB store at load 489. No run wrote the project registry. Intent itself was unaffected: its chain shim is gitignored under a relative core.hooksPath, so a linked worktree finds no carrier body. The carrier now exits on post-checkout when the previous HEAD is the null object id, a fresh checkout, with one line naming the first `intent` verb or `intent sync --apply`; a branch switch inside an existing checkout still syncs, and post-merge and post-rewrite are unchanged. The new arm a_fresh_worktree_builds_no_store_and_a_switch_inside_it_still_syncs was red with the template reverted and green with it.
